name: Galaxy Supermarket Ltd (Galaxy Cloud Kitchens)
tagline: Mumbai/Gurugram cloud-kitchen microcap; revenue spikes keep coming with negative capital returns and repeated 'margin-masking' warnings
business_overview: Galaxy Supermarket Ltd (now branded Galaxy Cloud Kitchens) runs cloud kitchens in Mumbai and Gurugram, producing bakery, desserts, hot/cold meals, home-meal-convenience and ready-to-eat products. Microcap (~Rs 91 Cr) listed on BSE.
fundamentals_table: ROE ~16.6% headline; ROCE ~-24.7% (5-yr avg ROCE ~-11.3%) — capital destruction
Q4 FY26 net sales +28% QoQ / +120% YoY to ~Rs 11.9 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: Headline revenue growth is large (Q4 FY26 +120% YoY) but multi-year capital returns are negative — 5-year average ROCE about -11% and latest ROCE about -25%. Independent result commentary (MarketsMojo) has flagged, across successive quarters, that the revenue surge masks margin erosion and structural concerns. The old 108-stock screen recorded negative book value here on 2026-08-15; a small reported profit now suggests equity is no longer negative, but capital efficiency remains value-destructive and promoter holding is sliding.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Stock down ~54% over the last year and trading in the lower half of a wide 52-week band.
